metadata.description: Azure region. US regions only; default eastus2.
Lowercase prefix for resource names, e.g. "sagitec".
Per-customer JWT audience; must equal the `aud` Pype puts in this customer's tokens.
PUBLIC JWKS JSON of Pype's signing service for this customer (public keys only).
CIDR ranges allowed to reach the HTTPS front end (ingress IP allow-list). Include Pype egress addresses.
Postgres administrator (migration owner) password. azd generates it; never commit it.
Password for the PostgREST login role `authenticator`; set on the server by the migrate job.
Container images. Defaults point at images that are NOT published yet (no registry exists); override before deploying.
Storage account names are global, 3-24 lowercase letters and digits.
Full PostgREST connection string, built by the caller; stored as a secret, never output.
PUBLIC key set (JWKS JSON) of the signing service. The customer never holds a private key.
CIDR ranges allowed to reach the front end (Pype egress addresses plus the customer's own). Required: the front end is never open to the world by default.
Placeholder only. Pype issues the one-time enrollment token when the destination is attached; this template neither generates nor stores one.
